settings.customCharacterStyle: Use exact canonical older brother and younger brother identities from CHARACTER_SHEETS. Never change face, skin, hair, outfit, props, age or height relationship.
settings.customProjectStructure: 16 continuous scenes. Scene N+1 starts from Scene N end frame. One action, one camera move, one speaker maximum. No teleporting, no duplicate brothers, no minecart or track reset.

movie.storyTitle: Roblox Brothers Adventure EP02 — รถรางเหมืองสุดป่วน
movie.storySummary: สองพี่น้องพบรถรางเหมืองในด่านใต้ดิน นั่งรถผ่านอุโมงค์ สวิตช์ราง สะพานขาด และทางลาด ก่อนช่วยกันหยุดรถที่สถานีปลายทางและออกจากเหมืองอย่างปลอดภัย
movie.mainStoryPrompt: One continuous minecart adventure. Exact same two brothers across all scenes. Minecart position, track direction, switch state and carried props must persist scene to scene.

scenes.title: ประตูเหมือง
scenes.continuityStartState: Canonical brothers stand together outside a bright blocky mine entrance; no cart yet touched.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother notices a parked minecart inside

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ซีชาร์ป มีรถรางด้วย

scenes.imageDescription: HARD IDENTITY LOCK. Same canonical brothers. Bright mine entrance, one parked minecart visible ahead, no text/UI.
scenes.videoPrompt: Use Character Sheets. Gentle push toward parked cart. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand beside the same parked minecart; older left, younger right; cart faces deeper into tunnel.

scenes.title: ขึ้นรถราง
scenes.continuityStartState: Same parked cart, same brother positions from Scene 1 end.
scenes.mainAction: older brother boards first and helps younger brother into same cart

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ขึ้นช้าๆนะ

scenes.imageDescription: Character Sheets + previous scene. Same cart and tunnel orientation. Older brother already seated, younger stepping in.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium side shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both brothers sit in same cart, older rear-left, younger front-right; cart still stationary on track.

scenes.title: รถเริ่มไหล
scenes.continuityStartState: Both seated in stationary cart exactly as Scene 2 end.
scenes.mainAction: cart begins rolling slowly into tunnel

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: มันไปเองแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers seated in same cart. Track enters bright safe tunnel; cart just starting forward.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear three-quarter tracking with cart. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Cart has moved deeper into tunnel; both still seated; first fork and lever become visible ahead.

scenes.title: ทางแยก
scenes.continuityStartState: Moving cart approaches visible fork and side lever.
scenes.mainAction: older brother points to safe left branch while younger reaches toward lever

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: เอารางซ้าย

scenes.imageDescription: Previous cart state. Same brothers, same moving cart; fork directly ahead, lever on younger brother side.
scenes.videoPrompt: Front three-quarter view from trackside. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Younger brother hand is on lever; cart almost at fork; left branch selected visually but lever not yet fully pulled.

scenes.title: สับรางทันเวลา
scenes.continuityStartState: Younger brother hand on lever, cart nearly at fork, left branch target.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother pulls lever once and switch locks left
scenes.imageDescription: Same fork geometry and cart. Lever visibly changes once; track switch aligns left.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close lever action then pan to wheels taking left branch. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Cart fully committed to left branch; fork behind remains set left; tunnel narrows ahead.

scenes.title: อุโมงค์แคบ
scenes.continuityStartState: Cart rolling on left branch into narrower tunnel.
scenes.mainAction: both duck slightly under a low safe beam

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ก้มหัวหน่อย

scenes.imageDescription: Same cart, same seating, narrow tunnel and one low padded beam. No reset.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side tracking as cart passes beam. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Cart clears beam; both sit upright again; broken bridge gap appears far ahead with brake handle visible in cart.

scenes.title: เห็นสะพานขาด
scenes.continuityStartState: Cart has cleared low beam and continues toward visible broken bridge gap.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother spots the gap and points

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ข้างหน้าสะพานขาด

scenes.imageDescription: Same moving cart and brothers. Broken section ahead; brake handle beside older brother.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward POV-like trackside reveal then return to brothers. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Older brother grips brake handle; cart still moving but gap closer; both faces alert.

scenes.title: เบรกฉุกเฉิน
scenes.continuityStartState: Older brother hand on brake; moving cart nearing gap.
scenes.mainAction: older brother pulls brake and cart stops before broken edge

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: หยุดทันพอดี

scenes.imageDescription: Previous scene state. Same cart stops a safe distance before gap. Wheels aligned on same track.
scenes.videoPrompt: Short forward movement decelerating to stop. Only older brother speaks after stop.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Cart stationary before gap; both brothers step-ready; maintenance side walkway and repair planks visible beside track.

scenes.title: ลงจากรถ
scenes.continuityStartState: Cart stationary before gap; side walkway and planks visible.
scenes.mainAction: both climb out onto side walkway, older brother first

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ไปดูทางกัน

scenes.imageDescription: Same stationary cart left behind at exact spot. Brothers step onto safe walkway, no teleport.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium side shot. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both stand beside broken rail; cart remains parked behind; older brother holds one repair plank, younger points at matching slot.

scenes.title: ซ่อมราง
scenes.continuityStartState: Older holds repair plank; younger points to slot; cart parked behind.
scenes.mainAction: older brother places plank while younger steadies edge

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: จับไว้ตรงนี้

scenes.imageDescription: Same broken bridge state. One repair plank installed across missing support; brothers work together.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close action shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Bridge support repaired and rail visually continuous; cart still behind them; both turn back toward cart.

scenes.title: กลับขึ้นรถ
scenes.continuityStartState: Track repaired; both facing parked cart behind.
scenes.mainAction: they return and sit in same seats as before
scenes.imageDescription: Repaired bridge remains ahead; cart unchanged. Younger front-right, older rear-left after boarding.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow to cart, no cut reset. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both seated; brake released; cart begins rolling toward repaired bridge.

scenes.title: ข้ามสะพาน
scenes.continuityStartState: Cart starts toward repaired bridge; same seating and track.

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ผ่านได้แล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same repaired track. Cart rolls across one repaired span; brothers remain seated.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low side tracking showing wheels over repair. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Cart clears bridge; repaired section behind; downhill curve begins ahead.

scenes.title: ทางลงเร็ว
scenes.continuityStartState: Cart just cleared bridge and enters downhill curve.
scenes.mainAction: cart speeds up while both hold cart sides

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เร็วขึ้นแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers and cart. Curved downhill track, no jump or reset.
scenes.videoPrompt: Banked side follow, playful speed. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Cart exits curve onto straight track; station lights visible ahead; brake handle beside older brother.

scenes.title: สถานีปลายทาง
scenes.continuityStartState: Cart on straight track, station visible ahead, still moving quickly.
scenes.mainAction: older brother gradually pulls brake to slow cart

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ค่อยๆ เบรก

scenes.imageDescription: Same cart and station approach. Older brother on brake; younger stays seated.
scenes.videoPrompt: Front three-quarter tracking with visible deceleration. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Cart stops at station marker; both still seated; exit stairs visible beside platform.

scenes.title: ลงสถานี
scenes.continuityStartState: Cart stationary at station; exit stairs beside platform.
scenes.mainAction: both climb out and walk to exit stairs
scenes.imageDescription: Same cart remains parked at station. Brothers walk together toward stairs, exact identities unchanged.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow from cart to stairs. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand at top of stairs facing bright exit portal; minecart remains visible below.

scenes.title: ออกจากเหมือง
scenes.continuityStartState: Brothers at top of stairs facing bright exit; minecart below behind them.
scenes.mainAction: they walk through exit together and celebrate safely outside

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ภารกิจสำเร็จ

scenes.imageDescription: Character Sheets + previous scene. Same brothers emerge outside mine; no cart teleport, no text/UI.
scenes.videoPrompt: Warm front three-quarter reveal outside. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both stand together outside mine entrance; episode complete; mine adventure state remains behind them.
